summary: Globus Maritime filed a Form 6-K containing its annual meeting proxy statement, with a press release announcing the meeting scheduled for September 17, 2026, in Glyfada, Greece. The record date is July 20, 2026. The filing is a routine annual meeting notice with no special-situation elements such as mergers, tender offers, or activist campaigns. Proxy materials were made available on the company's website. As a foreign private issuer, this 6-K corresponds to a U.S. proxy filing but is not a special-situation event. Investors should monitor upcoming shareholder resolutions, but no deal-related action is indicated.
